title: Days of the Week
label: ch:hi-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name all seven days of the week in Hindi and say which planet each day is named for.

payoff.summary: Recite सोमवार through रविवार end to end, naming Saturn's day and the Sun's day to close the planet-week.
payoff.note: HL12 added a one-character recognition segment at the end of this chapter, and its atom is not in this payoff -- so the ratio moved from 2/4 (0.50, exactly on the floor) to 2/5 (0.40, below it). Recorded rather than papered over. The payoff is not widened, and deliberately: this chapter promises something the reader can DO with the language, and recognising a character is the other ramp. HL12 section 2.1 keeps those apart on purpose, so folding a letter into a speaking payoff would make the chapter's promise less true, not more. The right repair is a payoff for the script strand itself, which arrives with the strand's own chapter capability.
